description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Garland (Dark)] to user. Grants [Attach Dark with Stacking].

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: Six single attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Dark Ability Quick Cast 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], [200% ATB 1] to user.

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: Six single attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Dark Ability Quick Cast 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], [200% ATB 1] to user.

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Garland (Dark)
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode, triggers [Radiant Strike: Garland] after using Crystal Force abilities (max 2)

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Radiant Strike: Garland
description.text: Grants [Physical +30% Boost 2] to user/[Physical +30% Boost 2] to all allies if there are 0-2/3+ Warrior I allies in the party.

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
